Create windows.ini in the workspace with the exact bytes represented by this JSON string: "; Keep Windows CRLF
[client]
timeout=30
retries=2
". The escaped CR and LF pairs represent actual Windows CRLF line endings, not literal backslashes. Use the native hashline read/edit tools to change only timeout=30 to timeout=45, preserving all other bytes, all CRLF line endings and the final trailing CRLF. Read the final raw file back with the native file-reading tool and report what actually changed; correct any unintended formatting changes before declaring completion.
